title: Fix BigNumber deserialisation in Dish, and add tests
issueTitle: Bug report: Sum not working on list of numbers
why: The report gives the exact recipe and input, and the expected result is the sum of the listed numbers (92+21392+20437+20221+10857+12474+16607+19655+18221+20587+14631+17175+20496+16385+16188+14440+12327+5393 = 277578). The buggy build stays on Baking and never shows it.
